vi: Dựng envelope encryption end-to-end bằng Cloud KMS + Secret Manager: tạo key ring (container regional), crypto key (CMEK — KEK), gắn IAM binding least-privilege, và trỏ secret vào key để mọi version được CMEK-encrypt.

Giải thích envelope encryption chi tiết: Secret Manager gọi GenerateDataKey lên crypto key, nhận data key plaintext + bản wrapped, mã hoá giá trị tại chỗ bằng data key, lưu wrapped key cạnh ciphertext, lúc đọc gọi Decrypt để mở lại.

Viết Terraform google_kms_key_ring, google_kms_crypto_key (CMEK, rotation_period), google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member (binding member+role cho service agent + decrypt-only), google_secret_manager_secret (customer_managed_encryption trỏ CMEK), secret_version, và rotation Pub/Sub.
So sánh CMEK vs Google-managed key: CMEK tốn chi phí key nhưng audit log truy cập crypto key (ai decrypt), Google-managed key miễn phí nhưng không biết ai đọc secret; chọn theo yêu cầu compliance.

Giải thích vì sao GCP dùng IAM binding (member+role) không phải key policy như AWS, vòng đời version bất biến, lịch rotation phát Pub/Sub message (subscriber tự ghi version), và audit trail via Cloud Audit Logs.
en: Build end-to-end envelope encryption with Cloud KMS and Secret Manager: create a key ring (regional container), crypto key (CMEK — the KEK), bind IAM least-privilege, and point secrets to the key so every version is CMEK-encrypted.

Explain envelope encryption in detail: Secret Manager calls GenerateDataKey on the crypto key, receives plaintext data key plus wrapped copy, encrypts the value in-place with the data key, stores the wrapped key beside the ciphertext, and on read calls Decrypt to unwrap it.

Write Terraform for google_kms_key_ring, google_kms_crypto_key (CMEK with rotation_period), google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member (member-plus-role binding for the service agent plus decrypt-only roles), google_secret_manager_secret (customer_managed_encryption pointing to CMEK), secret_version, and rotation with Pub/Sub.

Compare CMEK versus Google-managed key: CMEK incurs key costs but audit logs show who decrypted (who accessed the crypto key), Google-managed is free but you never see who read the secret; choose based on compliance needs.

Explain why GCP uses IAM bindings (member plus role) instead of AWS-style key policies, immutable version lifecycle, rotation that emits Pub/Sub messages (subscribers write new versions), and audit trails through Cloud Audit Logs.
